name: capsule
description: In-house capsule (original design): a pill with a teal cap printed with a '>' and a cream body, joined by a gold collar. Each row is a string, one palette key per pixel. 'closed' (16x8) is thrown, recalled and flown as a message; 'open' (23x8) is the two halves pulled apart with light between them, the gap on the sprite's centre.
